subject.title: docs cat drops person smart chips from all output modes (plain, --plain, --json); readable only via --raw

question: Should `gog docs cat` render smart chips in the existing text output by default, or preserve exact text output and expose chips through an explicit flag or additive JSON fields?
rationale: `docs cat` is a stable scripting surface, and both AGENTS.md and VISION.md emphasize parseable output and discussion before script-visible behavior changes.

options.title: Add explicit chip-aware output
options.body: Preserve current text output while adding an opt-in flag or additive structured JSON chip field, then document the migration path.

options.title: Render chips by default
options.body: Fix the silent omission directly by rendering person, date, and richLink elements inline in existing text fields.

options.title: Structure JSON first
options.body: Add structured chip data to JSON now and defer the plain-text default decision.

recommendation.title: Add explicit chip-aware output
recommendation.body: Preserve current text output while adding an opt-in flag or additive structured JSON chip field, then document the migration path.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to both the current Docs read extractor and the merged smart-chip insertion surface.
